pages.text:
**Speeds:** carts run **twice as fast** on straight [[tin_rails]], ease down for corners, and are held at half speed on [[honey_rail|honey rails]]. [[bouncy_rail|Bouncy rails]] launch them by redstone strength.

**Quiet:** [[padded_rails]] muffle carts.

**Sorting:** the [[inspector_rail]] gives a signal by cart type.

**Carts:** the [[minecart_frame]] is the base for the [[ender_minecart]] (rides [[ender_rails]]), [[locomotive_cart]] (drives itself and tows trains), [[jingle_cart]] (plays music), [[freight_cart]] (cargo) and [[carriage]] (passengers).

Powered rail features, speeds and towing only work with the default minecart physics.
